title: Process Group
description: A non-executable node in the process hierarchy (Core Model §02, §05) — an APQC Level-1 category or a Level-2/3 group that leaf Processes roll up to. Gives the L1–L5 architecture real names, owners, objective links, and user-defined master data, so a management team can navigate the whole business by level. LOCKED addition.

id.description: Hierarchy id: a 2-letter domain (L1, e.g. CO) or a dotted path (L2/L3, e.g. CO.3).

level.description: Depth in the process hierarchy (1 = top-level category).

parent_ref.description: The group one level up (null for an L1 category).

objective_refs.description: Strategic objectives this level supports (X-matrix alignment can attach at any level 1–5).

custom.description: User-defined master-data metadata (free-form key/value) for this domain / group.
